id.description: The unique system identifier for this specific record (within the context of this migration/onboarding process).

remote_network_id.description: The unique identifier of the Remote Network object itself in the system.

remote_network_name.description: The user-friendly name given to the Remote Network.

site_id.description: The unique identifier of the physical or virtual site associated with this Remote Network. Required field. Expected to be a digit string (max 50 digits).
